build_light_conv_encoder: build a LightConvEncoder with configurable kernel sizes and positional embeddings for sequence encoding
create_encoder_layer: create a LightConvEncoderLayer with lightweight convolution and optional self-attention from config
encode_source_tokens: run the LightConvEncoder forward pass on source tokens and embeddings to get encoded output
reorder_encoder_output: reorder encoder output tensors by a new batch order for beam search decoding
tile_encoder_output: tile encoder output tensors along the batch dimension for parallel decoding
